The Life You’ve Been Working Toward
Is Closer Than You Think

I work with entrepreneurs and leaders navigating growth, transition, and what comes next.

The short assessment below helps bring clarity to where you are — and what kind of support, if any, makes sense next.

The Version of You That Built This Life...
It May be the Same Version Keeping You Stuck.

This short assessment reveals which “room” you're currently operating in and whether it's time to wreck it.

More clarity. Stronger leadership. A life built on your terms.

👇 If any of this feels familiar… watch these

Don’t overthink it. Just hit play and see what resonates.

Hi, I’m Jody.

At my core, I’m a husband, father, and friend; the roles that keep me grounded and shape everything I build.

Professionally, I’ve spent over two decades inside high-pressure creative and business environments, including work with CNN and Good Morning America, and as a Music Supervisor for The Bachelor franchise. I’ve collaborated on projects with Netflix, HBO, Sony, Warner Bros., Marvel, and Disney; helping entrepreneurs perform when clarity matters, decisions carry weight, and failure isn’t an option.

For years, my work was about helping studios tell better stories and execute under pressure.

Today, I help business owners, leaders and organizations do the same...not on a screen, but in their own lives and businesses.

I work with high-performing individuals and teams who feel constrained by the very identity that once drove their success — and who know effort is no longer the issue.

This is the work I call Wreck the Room™.

WHAT DOES "WRECK THE ROOM" MEAN"?

As life happens, we build walls.

Each brick represents an experience, expectation, win, or wound that shaped how we learned to operate. Over time, those walls become rooms we live and lead from.

At first, those rooms help us survive and succeed.

Eventually, they can become the very thing that limits us.

Wrecking the room means identifying what no longer serves you, tearing down what you’ve outgrown, and choosing how you want to operate next.
The Wreck the Room™ framework helps people Wreck-ognize the room they’re operating from, Wreck what’s limiting them, and intentionally Wrock the room they’re meant to be in.

Choose Your Next Step

If you’re here, chances are something already feels off.

Not broken. Not failing. Just no longer aligned with who you’re becoming.

Because everyone’s situation is different, the first step isn’t a program, it’s clarity.
